deadline.value: The page says to visit the School of Graduate Studies for deadlines, and the School table cannot be quoted cell by cell.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to this field, and the page says nothing on GRE.

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The quick guide describes teaching and seminar requirements but no funding rule.

entry_route.value: Students can enter with a bachelor's (about five years) or a master's (about four years).
entry_route.quote: If you enter the program with a master’s degree, you can complete your PhD in four years.

also.quote: If you come into the program directly from an undergraduate program, you can expect to invest about five years working on your PhD.

notes: Covers both the Mechanical Engineering and Aerospace Engineering PhDs (EMAE). The EMAE quick guide (https://engineering.case.edu/node/82451) describes teaching and seminar requirements but gives no admission or funding rule. Funded PhD openings are listed on a separate page that was not fetched.
